#docs
## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The dispute's id. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `dispute`. One of `dispute`. |
| `id` | `string` | The dispute's id. |
| `status` | `string` | The dispute's state. One of `needs_response`, `under_review`, `won`, `lost`, `closed`. |
| `reason` | `string` | The reason for the dispute, as the gateway or the processor reports it. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | The disputed amount, in minor units. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `funds_withdrawn` | `boolean` | True while the disputed funds are out of `cash`. |
| `provider_key` | `string` | The gateway of the disputed payment. |
| `provider_dispute_id` | `string` | The gateway's id for the dispute. Null when a person recorded the dispute. |
| `source` | `string` | Who reported the dispute: `gateway` (its dispute events) or `operator` (a person). One of `gateway`, `operator`. |
| `processor_reference` | `string` | The processor's case number. Only on a dispute that a person recorded. |
| `outcome_settable_by_operator` | `boolean` | True when you can set the outcome with `POST /v1/businesses/{biz}/disputes/{id}/outcome`: the dispute is open, and a person recorded it or its gateway does not send a final state. |
| `provider_charge_id` | `string` | The gateway's id for the disputed charge. |
| `payment_id` | `string` | The disputed payment's internal id. |
| `invoice_id` | `string` | The invoice's internal id. |
| `customer_id` | `string` | The customer's internal id. |
| `evidence_due_by` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the gateway wants the evidence. |
| `opened_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the dispute opened. |
| `closed_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the dispute closed. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When we recorded the dispute. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such dispute |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/disputes/dsp_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
